resources.string: No memories yet.\nTap \"Add Memory\" to start preserving your memories.

We believe that people hold onto things because of the memories attached to them — not the things themselves.

Hoarder's Scrapbook helps you preserve those memories by taking a photo of an item and writing down what it means to you. Once your memory is saved here, you can let the item go knowing the memory lives on.

Your saved memories appear as a slideshow on the home screen, so you can revisit them anytime.
